name: HUSTLE TIME
source:
A young man whose debts are building up, who's lost his job, and who's hit rock bottom.
In the bustling night district, where every appetite is fulfilled, his tale of revenge is about to start.

The protagonist's second life is about to start, managing the cabaret club Hustle.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ266482.html]DLsite English[/url]]
